name: Liquid blob
look: White metaball bodies with tar rims and marble contours on a flat blue pool; plate B is a relief map

axes.base: one flat blue, no texture but the grain
axes.line: one heavy tar outline on every body; thin marble contours inside
axes.tone: flat white bodies; tone is marble lines, never shading
axes.planB: relief: the same field drawn as a contour map (isolines at many levels)
axes.motion: everything flows: merges, splits, drips and melts at 24 fps; the rim boils
axes.accent: yolk yellow on one small thing
axes.match: a body's rim becomes the outer contour of the relief; morph cuts between shapes
